selection.summary: Collected base evidence for the DOM pretty-print feature (issue #1329): include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h shows the string_builder/mini_formatter design intended to support prettification, and serialization-inl.h shows parser::print_json using string_builder<> with no indentation support. No source patch could be applied because repository write tools are unavailable; the fix would add a pretty formatter (e.g., four-space indentation) and a to_string/print variant with documentation, but this repair is not verified.
